AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#353 @ 9d47045b63a4680d852591ae3b4b2d3bfb1e0d85 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/1/3

Job AUD-SOL-L3-121, agent 121; independent T4 billing/auth-state FIX ROUND 2 review.

### Prior Sol disposition first

**B-353-1 remains closed on stale/out-of-order provider reads; B-353-2 closes on retained destructive confirmations after screen/provider/auth retirement.** The confirmation captures its owner and shown purchase when the dialog opens; both screens refuse retired callbacks before dispatch, the provider rejects a retired owner before sending, and an already-sent cancellation reconciles only the same live account's server state. ([Current provider/screens](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353), [114/114 exact-source replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37355825712))

**B-353-3 closes on its reported future-grace/card-repair/missing-restart-facts scope:** dispute surfaces now state access ended/billing paused/coach decides, remove dispute deadlines and automatic restoration, lead with Message coach, and remove End my plan/Already paid/card-repair paths from the dispute lockout. ([FIX ROUND 2](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353#issuecomment-5999207763), [same-head mounted/legacy-envelope replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37355825712))

The distinct inquiry-money-truth edge below is not hidden by those closures; L1's native ownership finding belongs to #352 and is not counted again on this PR. ([L1 ownership scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352), [L2 changed surfaces](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353))

### B-353-8 — Inquiry lockout/banner/UpdateCard assert that the bank reversed money

`src/entitlements/dunning/DunningBanner.tsx:25-31`; `DunningLockoutScreen.tsx:69-75`; `UpdateCardScreen.tsx:87-95`: every accepted `kind:'dispute'` or `reason:'dispute_paused'` envelope unconditionally produces “A payment was reversed”, “Your bank reversed a payment”, or “Your bank took back a payment”, without proof of withdrawal. ([Exact candidate surfaces](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353))

**Concrete input:** an inquiry's normal dispute-paused envelope with `state:'locked'`, `purchase_id:'p_inquiry'`, no amount/currency/lock date, `access_ended:true`, `billing_paused:true`, `restart_by:'coach'`, and no card/cancel route is accepted by the normalizer and takes all three reversal branches; a waived `past_due` form also shows the reversed-payment headline. ([Accepted normalizer in L1](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352), [L2 branches and existing D2c fixture](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353))

Owner decision 6 includes inquiries in the pause/access-ending policy, while Stripe explicitly says no funds are withdrawn for an inquiry unless it becomes a dispute; these surfaces therefore report a money movement that did not occur. ([Binding owner register](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/tgp-agent-context/blob/main/TGP_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md), [Stripe inquiry contract](https://docs.stripe.com/testing-use-cases?locale))

**Minimal fix rule:** use neutral payment-dispute/inquiry language when the backend supplies no trustworthy withdrawal subtype, or condition reversal wording on such a subtype; keep the three pause/restart facts, working coach/support paths, no deadline or card fix, and ordinary failed-payment behavior. Update exact-string tests that currently require a reversal for the generic D2c envelope, then cover locked/waived inquiry, legacy unknown subtype and actual reversal controls. ([Affected code/tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353))

Three helper negatives and three mounted surface negatives plus an ordinary-payment control are in the consolidated mobile CI lane; they are **queued, not claimed executed or passing**, and the finding is supported by the explicit source branches and documented inquiry semantics. ([Queued proof lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37365609416), [Stripe semantics](https://docs.stripe.com/testing-use-cases?locale))

### Follow-ups (C; freeze, unchanged)

- **C-353-1 / original C-322-4:** `UpdateCardScreen.tsx:125-146,168-196,256-279`: bank/reconciliation locator, approval and last-known money remain component-owned; add account-owned non-secret restoration and a real mounted-screen restart test if same-action restart continuity is required, rather than labeling a hand-supplied helper context a device/remount proof. ([Candidate state/retry](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353), [original Sol disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392))
- **C-353-2 / #334 composition:** `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:239-244,290-302`: whichever stack lands second must retain the native UpdateCard route and compose the two dunning banners without restoring a hosted portal. ([Current route/composition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353), [carried Sol item](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353#issuecomment-5983779129))
- **C-353-4, outside this diff:** `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:284-287`: remove pre-existing “our servers” through the copy follow-up and include nearby rendered copy in voice coverage; not a new billing/auth blocker in this frozen round. ([Candidate neighboring copy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353), [prior Sol disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353#issuecomment-5983779129))

### Evidence reuse, CI and operator default

No other lens's current-round notes or verdict were read; this lens independently inspected every FIX ROUND 2 runtime delta and retained navigation/deep-link, support, entitlement/paywall and billing consumers.

The lower-head merge `b587e20f` reproduces automatic tree `b6d17a84cac2bb69efabed351bedb186a69a3206`; the verified prior Sol replay commit adds only audit tests/workflow to this exact head, so its **114/114** results apply to the unchanged runtime, not an inherited verdict. ([Builder merge/fix record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353#issuecomment-5999207763), [verified same-source CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37355825712))

Exact-head Typecheck/lint/test is green and the 2,723 changed lines fit the grandfathered 3,000 cap; main-target analyses absent on this stacked head are **not** counted green. ([Candidate CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37344789490), [candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353))

All probes now share one retained batch rooted at exact #354, whose L2 runtime files are byte-identical to this candidate; the prior individual lanes were canceled on the operator's one-in-flight instruction and no heavy local execution was used. ([Single retained batch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37365609416), [canceled L1 lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37365516729), [canceled L2 lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37365523330))

**Recommended default:** hold L2 for B-353-8 and the full train for L1's own Bs, use neutral inquiry/reversal copy without shrinking functionality, then replay/restack and obtain fresh exact-head dual verdicts; no new owner product decision is needed. Keep backend-first deployment, integrated main checks and native-device association/PaymentSheet/3DS acceptance as separate release gates. ([Binding register](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/tgp-agent-context/blob/main/TGP_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md), [prior landing contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353#issuecomment-5983779129))
